project.name: Cascada Library - Spark + Delta executor
project.description:
The production SparkQueryExecutorPort adapter: builds a Spark 4.1.1 SparkSession (local or Kubernetes â€” identical code, only config differs) with Delta Lake extensions, runs physical SQL over Delta tables, and maps the Spark Row result into the cache's framework-free ResultFrame. Ported from data_collector/src/core/spark/spark_manager.py + cluster-deployment/spark_configs.py.
Spark 4.1 supports Java 17 and 21. The cluster image supplies the matching Spark 4.1 / Scala 2.13 / Delta 4.1 runtime, so those dependencies are `provided` here; this module compiles against them and contributes the adapter + the pure, fully-tested config builder.
